newsitem.title: UK: LME trades over 42,000 TAPO copper puts in February.
newsitem.headline: LME trades over 42,000 TAPO copper puts in February.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) traded 42,549 lots of copper put options in February in its new Traded Average Price Option (TAPO) contract, against 1,484 calls.
February TAPO call open interest was 199 lots, while puts totalled 13,458 contracts, the LME said in its latest statistical bulletin.
In aluminium, the LME's other new TAPO contract, February turnover was 4,067 calls and 4,462 puts. Call option open interest was 590 lots, while puts was nil.
